listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom (EoWRecomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Echoes of Wisdom port translating AArch64 code to C with LAS-derived Vulkan/MoltenVK services. It is not fully playable: Linux reaches the opening and first controllable scene, with full progress, saves and PC features unfinished. The reviewed alpha_1 release has a Mac ARM64 ZIP, Android APK and checksums; Linux/Windows use source. Packages build your game locally. Apple Silicon macOS 15+ and Android ARM64 package tests covered setup without the game. Windows x64 was cross-built, with setup/game untested and no Windows release file. Use your own version 1.0.0 title 01008CF01BAAC000 without updates and prod.keys, as NSP/XCI/NCA. Generated code still reads original package data. Separate firmware, region and hashes are unspecified. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
